message.content:
{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study validates an AI-PBPK platform against human PK data, reporting error ranges for AUC predictions, which quantifies agreement between model predictions (derived from animal extrapolation) and human outcomes.",
  "arm": "methods-and-bias",
  "arm_evidence": "The AI-PBPK approach was validated against human PK data of 71 intravenous and 606 oral administrations collected from the PK-DB database.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "cross-cutting"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Optimal pharmacokinetic (PK) profile, including tissue distribution, is pivotal for a drug achieving success in clinical trials.",
  "model_type": "in-vitro-or-in-silico-comparator",
  "model_evidence": "This study aims to develop an integrated artificial intelligence (AI) and physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) platform to rapidly estimate drug in vivo fate based solely on molecular structures.",
  "species": [
    "not-species-specific"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The AI models were trained to predict eight types of key properties (solubility, pKa values, crystal density, intrinsic dissolution rate, apparent permeability, protein unbound fraction, plasma clearance, and tissue partition coefficients for 15 organs), from which the PBPK model forecasted PK curves without further training.",
  "endpoint_class": "secondary-biomarker",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The results were robust, with most of the AUC predictions falling within two and threefold error ranges."
}
